name: subagent-gateway-dev
description: Git hooks only. The plugin itself has no dependencies; this file exists so lefthook and commitlint run the hookset presets.

scripts.hook:verify: npm run lint:guidance && claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin test .
scripts.hook:triggerlist: git cat-file -e origin/main:.sdlc/checklist.yaml 2>/dev/null || { echo "triggerlist: origin/main has no .sdlc/checklist.yaml yet, protect skipped" >&2; exit 0; }; triggerlist protect origin/main
